name: PARA
notes: 3 photos, all PARA menu cards at 949 2nd St, Encinitas (matches manifest address). Photos 1-2 are front/back of one laminated card (All Day Brunch/Espresso/Specialty Espresso on front, Non-Espresso/Para Specials/Matcha on back). Photo 3 is a separate two-column paper menu with more breakfast items and some different prices for overlapping items; used photo 3's pricing where an item appears on both, and kept unique items/prices from photos 1-2 otherwise. Ham & Swiss Croissant, Lentil Soup, and both ice creams had prices cut off in photo 3 so price is omitted.
